title: Kita-Kita attendee import row
description: One CSV row for Kita-Kita People import. Use canonical column names. Extra properties are not part of the contract: do not send government IDs, birthdates, health data, or other PII beyond these fields (RA 10173 data minimization). The parser ignores unknown columns.

id.description: Stable attendee identifier from the source system. Duplicate ids in the same file are skipped. Import merges by case-insensitive id and does not clear existing check-ins.

first_name.description: Given name. Header aliases: firstname, first, First Name.

last_name.description: Family name. Header aliases: lastname, last, Last Name.

email.description: Optional contact email. Normalized to lowercase on import. Header aliases: email_address. Invalid values skip the row.

phone_number.description: Optional E.164 phone (leading +, 8–15 digits, first digit 1–9). Header aliases: phone, phonenumber, mobile, contact_number. Invalid values skip the row.
